# GitHub Copilot adapter

Use [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical repository instruction set.

For substantive work in a RESEARCH workspace:

- read `GRO.md`, `brain.md`, the project brief, and status;
- work through the active Issue/branch/PR context;
- use only the relevant `research-*` skill;
- preserve evidence provenance and explicit uncertainty;
- do not bypass the Issue/PR workflow.

This file is an adapter only. Do not maintain a second copy of the research rules here.
